answer: Each identity must forge one river anchor and moor it in the harbor: the k-th anchor from one funder costs 20 x k units of stake, so N fakes cost 10N(N+1) in total, 110 for 10, 10,100 for 100. A harbor inspection sinks any anchor sharing a forge mark, and the stake of every sunk anchor is burned, so clones cannot pool one anchor across identities.
